onchain.mvrv_z_method: reconstructed: (market cap - realized cap) / sample stdev(full-history market cap); realized cap = market cap / MVRV

exchange_flows.sign_convention: positive net inflow = exchange inflows exceeded outflows

lth.reason: true LTH supply/flow is not available in Coin Metrics Community; no proxy age band is substituted

onchain.status_note: Coin Metrics flash values can back-revise; current values are descriptive unless the framework explicitly scores them

onchain_empty.reason: need >=30 usable daily Coin Metrics rows; got 0

premium.method: Coinbase USD close / (Binance USDT close x Coinbase USDT-USD close) - 1
premium.note: completed UTC daily closes only; current partial day excluded

premium_empty.reason: need >=3 aligned completed daily closes; got 0

oi.scope_note: Binance USD-M single-venue open interest; not market-wide OI

oi_empty.reason: need >=80 distinct archived days for a 90d claim; got 0

breadth.method: close > SMA200; equal does not count as above

sentiment.note: DISCLOSED REGIME CONTEXT ONLY — not a scored leg input. Both proxies were tested over 10y on 2026-08-05 and failed as scored inputs (GVZ: no gradient; PHYS premium: era-dependent, effective N~16). The sentiment leg keeps its NOT-FOUND fallback of 2.

vol_index.interpretation: direction-blind — a high print means turbulence, NOT fear; never read as a fear signal

cef_premium.interpretation: discount = investors paying below metal value (fear-shaped); UNSCORED — the signal is era-dependent and did not survive split-half validation
